zh: 賓州一架Citation CJ1起飛時墜毀起火，兩人受傷
en: A Cessna Citation CJ1 crashed and caught fire during takeoff in Pennsylvania; both occupants survived.

zh: 易捷航空削減冬季班表，涉及70萬個座位
en: easyJet cuts its winter schedule, removing 700,000 seats.

zh: RwandAir執行長呼籲為非洲單一航空市場設定落實期限
en: RwandAir chief calls for deadlines to implement Africa’s single aviation market

zh: Edgewing在義大利杜林啟用GCAP首座工程中心
en: Edgewing opens its first GCAP engineering hub in Italy.

zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯航空機師在利雅德機場遇襲身亡，一架停放客機受損
en: Saudia pilot killed, parked aircraft damaged in attack on Riyadh airport

zh: IATA於CORSIA十週年呼籲政府強化全球航空排放框架
en: IATA calls for stronger government support for CORSIA.

zh: 美國陸軍報告指出通訊中斷促成致命相撞
en: U.S. Army report cites interrupted transmissions in fatal collision

zh: 澳洲航空計畫2027年在A380推出付費加長腿部空間區
en: Qantas plans paid extra-legroom seating on A380s from 2027.

zh: 美國海軍追加資金支持Shield AI開發X-BAT
en: US Navy awards Shield AI another $150 million for X-BAT development.
